comments.text:
Completed implementation of the ristretto theme:
- Added standalone static/themes/ristretto.css based on Antharchy/Omarchy ristretto color palette.
- Added 'ristretto' to AVAILABLE_THEMES in markusmd.themes.
- Added [data-theme="ristretto"] styles to static/markus.css.
- Added BDD feature scenarios in features/themes.feature and updated features/site.feature.
- Verified with behave (all 55 scenarios passing) and ruff lint.
